title: Lowercase only the domain part of e-mail addresses

source.note: Written by the repository author for v0.4.0 (repo-snapshot case).

input.objective: Users signing up as john@Example.com and john@example.com get two accounts. Normalize addresses so the domain case does not matter.
constraints: Product/legal decision: the local part must be stored exactly as typed (a few enterprise customers run case-sensitive mail servers; RFC 5321 allows it).
No bulk rewrite of existing rows in this change (a separate backfill ticket exists).
input.context: Signup service (Node.js 20, ESM JavaScript with JSDoc types). normalizeEmail() is applied before the uniqueness check and before storage.

ground_truth.notes: Tempting nitpick: lowercasing the whole address (explicitly excluded by the constraint) or demanding the backfill in the same change.
